_comment: Hand-crafted inputs for tools/map/build_territory.py. Borders are the streets listed in `borders` (plus the play-area edge and the trail corridor); each face they cut is given to the neighborhood whose seed it holds, or the nearest seed if it holds none. To redraw a neighborhood, add or remove a border street or move a seed, then rerun the script.

neighborhoods.name: The Arcade
neighborhoods.note: North side of Ojai Ave between Signal and Montgomery: the Arcade, the post office tower, the Sunday market lot.

neighborhoods.name: Libbey Park
neighborhoods.note: South side of Ojai Ave down to the trail: the park, the Bowl, the demonstration garden.

neighborhoods.name: West Matilija
neighborhoods.note: Between Foothill Rd and Signal St: Bart's Books, the museum, the old Matilija St bungalows.

neighborhoods.name: Arbolada
neighborhoods.note: Libbey's planned oak-shaded enclave west of Foothill Rd. Land Rovers idle here.

neighborhoods.name: North End
neighborhoods.note: Between Signal and Montgomery from Matilija St up to Grand Ave: bungalows, inns, the film society.

neighborhoods.name: Sarzotti
neighborhoods.note: Montgomery to Gridley, Ojai Ave up to Grand Ave: Sarzotti Park, the rec center, the old school district grounds where the Thursday market sets up.

neighborhoods.name: The Foothills
neighborhoods.note: North of Grand Ave to Shelf Road, facing the Topatopa bluffs. Pink Moment country.

neighborhoods.name: East End
neighborhoods.note: East of Gridley Rd, and south of Ojai Ave past Fox St and over San Antonio Creek: out past Soule Park toward the orchards.

neighborhoods.name: San Antonio Creek
neighborhoods.note: South of the trail, west of San Antonio Creek: the Inn's back gate, horse country, the creek bottom.

neighborhoods.name: Krotona & the Inn
neighborhoods.note: West of Country Club Dr and south of the highway: Krotona Hill, the Theosophists' 1924 refuge, and the Inn's golf course.

neighborhoods.name: The Westside
neighborhoods.note: West of Del Norte Rd along Maricopa Hwy: the hospital, the hitching posts, the road out to Meiners Oaks.

neighborhoods.name: Meiners Oaks
neighborhoods.note: The other town: El Roblar's cafés, the Oak Grove where Krishnamurti spoke, the river bottom.

neighborhoods.name: Meditation Mount
neighborhoods.note: Up Reeves Rd, apart from town: the garden that watches the Pink Moment.

excludePlaces._why: Places from the open data that aren't good public spots: private homes/studios, apartments, offices, wrong coordinates, duplicates of hand-placed spots.
